title: HyMem: Hierarchical Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents via Information Isolation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15703v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents often perform poorly on complex, long-horizon tasks because their context becomes increasingly cluttered over time. As interactions accumulate, detailed execution traces and intermediate outputs dominate the context, making it difficult for the model to retain and use high-level planning information. Most existing methods address this issue through compression or retrieval applied to a single, flat context, which does not clearly separate different types of context information and often leads to degraded reasoning. To address this challenge, we propose HyMem, a hierarchical framework that explicitly separates the agent's context into distinct functional layers. HyMem organizes context by function to separate high-level planning from execution and complex analysis. translated_title: HyMem：通过信息隔离实现长时程智能体的层级上下文管理
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在复杂的长时间跨度任务中往往表现不佳，因为其上下文会随时间推移变得越来越杂乱。随着交互的累积，详细的执行轨迹和中间输出主导了上下文，使得模型难以保留和利用高层规划信息。大多数现有方法通过压缩或检索应用于单一、扁平的上下文来解决此问题，这未能清晰区分不同类型的上下文信息，常导致推理能力下降。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了HyMem，一个层级框架，明确将智能体的上下文划分为不同的功能层。HyMem按功能组织上下文，以分离高层规划与执行及复杂分析。其隔离的推理模块处理复杂子任务，而无需将中间推理轨迹添加到持久的规划上下文中，同时...
tldr: HyMem提出了一种层级上下文管理框架，通过信息隔离将高层规划与执行和复杂分析分离，从而提升长时程智能体在复杂任务中的推理性能。
en_tdlr: HyMem proposes a hierarchical context management framework that separates high-level planning from execution and complex analysis via information isolation, enhancing reasoning performance of long-horizon agents in complex tasks.
